description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thimbirigaswewa, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and legal status. The content focuses on land property matters, specifically title settlement and registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories that would take precedence over this land-focused content.
